name: hwaseong-fortress
description: Wall follows both hill and flat ground. Two-storey Janganmun north and Paldalmun south gates; single-storey Hwaseomun west and Changnyongmun east; fired-brick half-moon ravelins, Hwahongmun floodgate over Suwoncheon; modern road openings remain open.
attribution: Plans: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Architectural geometry originally authored for Vearth.

audit.grounding: Fixed production-provider anchor datum; geometry follows sampled local ground. No whole-site flattening.
audit.dimension_uncertainty: Mapped horizontal plans are measured; unreferenced architectural heights, ornament spacing and small details are visual interpretations, not a conservation survey.
audit.orientation: Geometry is authored directly in east/north coordinates, so runtime heading is zero.

geometry: original metric geometry authored for Low Poly Earth from cited architectural references
